description: This file defines the class OAuthTokenMarkDeletedService, which contains methods to update OAuth2 tokens marked for deletion based on expiration dates and revoke status. It includes database interaction, logging, and configuration loading functionalities.

classes.name: OAuthTokenMarkDeletedService
classes.description: Service class responsible for marking OAuth2 tokens as deleted based on expiration and revoke status.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the update query to mark tokens as deleted based on configured thresholds.

methods.name: getDBManager
methods.description: Retrieves the database manager instance used for database operations.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with specified level and optional section tag.

methods.name: getOAuthTokenDeleteThreshold
methods.description: Retrieves the configured threshold for token deletion, defaulting to '-7 days' if invalid or not set.
